title: Apple Unveils M6-Powered Entry-Level MacBook Pro and iMac
summary:
The company's updated 14-inch laptop will hit shelves on Nov. 6, with pricing for the base configuration starting at $1,999. Along with the new entry-level MacBook Pro, Apple also announced a refreshed iMac, both of which utilize the recently unveiled M6 processor. Pre-orders for the new hardware open on Oct. 28.

The MacBook Pro features a 12-core CPU and 12-core GPU with up to 32GB of unified memory, providing 25% faster AI processing and 1.9x the Neural Engine performance of the M5 chip. Additional updates include Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6, faster charging and battery life of up to 24 hours.

Apple $AAPL unveiled its new 14-inch MacBook Pro powered by the M6 chip, featuring a 12-core CPU and 12-core GPU.

The new model offers up to 30% faster graphics, 25% faster AI workloads and 1.9x faster Neural Engine performance compared with M5.

It also comes with Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6 and up to 24 hours of battery life.

Starting at $1,999, with preorders opening October 28 and availability beginning November 6.
